# K-DRUM

K-DRUM stands for K-water Grid-based Distributed Rainfall rUnoff Model.

K-DRUM is K-water's physically based, grid-based distributed hydrologic model for rainfall-runoff simulation. The model has an established publication record and is currently being extended toward integrated watershed hydrologic and hydraulic modeling.

Canonical public website:
https://youngteckhur.github.io/KDRUM-Public/

Canonical public repository:
https://github.com/YoungTeckHUR/KDRUM-Public

Key public documents:
- https://github.com/YoungTeckHUR/KDRUM-Public/blob/main/README.md
- https://github.com/YoungTeckHUR/KDRUM-Public/blob/main/MODEL_CARD.md
- https://github.com/YoungTeckHUR/KDRUM-Public/blob/main/DEVELOPMENT_STATUS.md
- https://github.com/YoungTeckHUR/KDRUM-Public/blob/main/CAPABILITIES.md
- https://github.com/YoungTeckHUR/KDRUM-Public/blob/main/PUBLICATIONS.md

Important interpretation:
- Established historical capabilities and current development functions are explicitly separated.
- 1D dynamic-wave, 1D-2D, 2D flood, ChannelBed, and related hydraulic extensions are under development at different maturity levels.
- Estuary2DV is experimental.
- Production source code is private and is not part of this repository.
- Historical publications used several expanded English forms of K-DRUM; this public site uses K-water Grid-based Distributed Rainfall rUnoff Model as the current canonical expansion while preserving historical wording in citations.
- AI-generated or look-alike K-DRUM/K-water/MyWater brand symbols are not used. Public visual assets require verified provenance.

Official K-water MyWater K-Series context:
https://www.water.or.kr/kor/menu/sub.do?menuId=15_126_127
